Barbarian.name: Path of the Berserker
Barbarian.description: Turn Rage into relentless offense. Reckless attacks can add Frenzy damage, while later features strengthen your resolve, let you retaliate, and terrify foes.

Bard.name: College of Lore
Bard.description: Gather knowledge from many traditions. Gain additional skills, hinder enemies with Cutting Words, and discover spells beyond the Bard list.

Cleric.name: Life Domain
Cleric.description: Channel divine power to protect and restore life. Your domain provides healing spells, improves healing, and helps preserve allies in danger.

Druid.name: Circle of the Land
Druid.description: Draw magic from a chosen landscape. Change your land after a Long Rest to gain its circle spells, and later gain nature-based protection and sanctuary.

Fighter.name: Champion
Fighter.description: Pursue physical excellence in combat. Improve your critical-hit range, athleticism, Fighting Style options, and resilience.

Monk.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
Monk.description: Master unarmed combat. Your Flurry of Blows can disrupt enemies, and later features improve recovery, mobility, and focused strikes.

Paladin.name: Oath of Devotion
Paladin.description: Uphold justice and protect the vulnerable. Empower a weapon with Channel Divinity and gain oath spells and a protective aura.

Ranger.name: Hunter
Ranger.description: Study marked prey and choose hunting techniques. Learn a target's defenses, adapt your offense and defense, and improve your attacks against marked foes.

Rogue.name: Thief
Rogue.description: Excel at infiltration, exploration, and using treasure. Gain swift object interactions and mobility, then learn to make greater use of magic items.

Sorcerer.name: Draconic Sorcery
Sorcerer.description: Manifest magic linked to dragons. Gain draconic resilience and spells, then develop greater elemental power and draconic abilities.

Warlock.name: Fiend Patron
Warlock.description: Draw power from a mighty fiend of the Lower Planes. Gain patron spells, temporary vitality, protection, and other infernal gifts.

Wizard.name: Evoker
Wizard.description: Specialize in evocation magic. Shape destructive spells around allies and strengthen the damage of your evocations.
